title_en: Prayer of Azariah and Song of the Three Holy Children
title_fa: دعای عزریا و سرود سه جوان
title_hr: Molitva Azarijina i Pjesma trojice mladića
audit_reason: Verse 55 in the imported English snapshot duplicates the mountains line; canonical Song of the Three reading is fountains. This localized correction aligns FA/HR with that reading; the runtime English display is normalized by the audit overlay loader.

verses.text_fa: ای چشمه‌ها، خداوند را متبارک خوانید؛ او را تا ابد برتر از همه بستایید و سرافراز سازید.
verses.text_hr: Izvori, blagoslivljajte Gospodina; hvalite ga i uzvisujte dovijeka.
